create_LogStddevNormal_distribution: create a LogStddevNormal distribution with loc, log_scale, and optional max_scale parameters
create_LogStddevNormal_with_max_scale: create a LogStddevNormal distribution with max_scale to apply soft thresholding on the scale parameter
access_log_scale_property: access the log_scale property of a LogStddevNormal distribution to get the log standard deviation
index_LogStddevNormal_distribution: index into a LogStddevNormal distribution batch to extract a subset of distributions
compute_KL_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two LogStddevNormal distributions using the registered KL function
